topic: Performance Optimization: Reducing Procedure Call Overhead
explanation: Procedure calls introduce overhead due to function prologue/epilogue, stack manipulation, and branch prediction mis-predictions.  In performance-critical sections, this overhead can significantly impact execution time. Reducing procedure calls improves performance by minimizing these overheads, allowing for more efficient instruction execution and better utilization of the processor pipeline.
